name: Recovery-action router
purpose: Owns the mapping from a state's recovery shape (parent-surface, search, request-access, retry, create, clear-filters) to a concrete rendered control on the state region. The router is the second layer under the state machine; every state that renders passes its recovery shape through the router.
responsibilities: Realise the parent-surface shape as a link with data-recovery="parent-surface" whose href points to the FBS-declared parent path (AC-22101-1, AC-22106-1 when the empty-list has a parent).
Realise the search shape as a search entry with data-recovery="search" (AC-22101-1, AC-22107-1).
Realise the request-access shape as a button with data-action="request-access" that POSTs to the FBS-configured request-access endpoint (AC-22102-1, AC-22104-1).
Realise the retry shape as a button with data-recovery="retry" that re-issues the failed operation (AC-22103-1, AC-22105-1, AC-22108-1).
Realise the create shape as a link or button with data-recovery="create" (AC-22106-1) and the clear-filters shape as a button with data-recovery="clear-filters" (AC-22107-1).
internalStructure: One router module the state machine hands each state's recovery shape. The router reads the FBS-configured parent path, request-access endpoint and clear-filters callback and constructs the rendered control. Refuses to render a state without a legitimate recovery shape (an authored no-recovery notice is a legitimate shape; a bare state region without any recovery is a build defect).

interfaces.name: renderRecovery
interfaces.description: renderRecovery({ shape, config }) -> { element, dataRecoveryAttr, dataActionAttr }. shape is one of parent-surface, search, request-access, retry, create, clear-filters, no-recovery. config carries the FBS-declared paths and callbacks the router needs.

dependencies.name: State machine
dependencies.description: The router runs downstream of the state machine's dispatch.

tradeoffs: A closed set of recovery shapes keeps the state matrix testable but constrains projects that want a bespoke recovery flow to compose a wider shape as no-recovery with a project-side custom region. A future v1.1.0 minor bump can add a request-access-inline shape (inline form rather than a POST) when demand warrants.
notes: The recovery-shape enum is closed at v1: parent-surface, search, request-access, retry, create, clear-filters, no-recovery. A new shape is a blueprint minor bump.
